relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine, a selective NaV1.8 inhibitor that was recently approved in the US for acute postoperative pain

relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: adjunctive suzetrigine use was associated with lower postoperative opioid requirements after head and neck free flap reconstruction and transoral robotic surgery

key_findings: In a retrospective cohort of 146 patients, adjunctive suzetrigine was associated with lower inpatient opioid use after head and neck surgery with similar pain scores.
